name: PAD-OSK
description: On-screen keyboard that injects keys via Clutter.VirtualInputDevice, so it works with Electron/Chromium apps (QQ, Chrome) that never speak text-input-v3. Lives inside the shell, so it never steals keyboard focus. The gear button opens a detached settings card: five key sizes, four preset palettes plus a custom colour picker (panel/key/modifier/pressed/accent, each with presets, a spectrum and a hex field), panel transparency, corner radius, a backdrop image, links to the project site and releases, and a one-tap reset to defaults.
